eps.o: Gabby and friends enjoy the a-meow-zing lights of Fairylandia for the first time and get ready for the secret world's biggest celebration of the year!
One of MerCat's magic potions makes Kitty Fairy lose her wings. Can Gabby and the gang help Kitty Fairy get her wings back on her special day?
Follow Gabby and pals for a paw-some tea party in Fairylandia! The group decorates stuffed bears, bakes cookies and takes a magical tea cup ride.
Pandy picks a name for a cute Kitty-Pillar friend, then the Gabby Cats serve some tasty fruits and veggies to help her grow into a Kitty-Butterfly!

It's Opposite Day in the Dollhouse, and to celebrate the occasion, Gabby unboxes Opposite Cat, who can make any opposite magic happen! Whether it's upside down, slow and fast, short and tall, big and small, all the Gabby Cats' opposite dreams come true.
